leadership.title: Leadership academy
leadership.purpose: The Enterprise Nuclear Leadership Academy as a pathway: the ladder from individual contributor to executive, each programme with its published facts, my leadership readiness and my nominations.

leadership-programme.title: Leadership programme
leadership-programme.purpose: One academy programme: published facts with their source, who it is for, what it builds and how to join.

leadership-360.title: Leadership 360
leadership-360.purpose: Leadership behaviours feedback from colleagues: shown only as averages and only with five or more responses.

leadership-nominations.title: Leadership nominations
leadership-nominations.purpose: Line managers nominate people they manage; the HR authority or the training manager decides (maker-checker).

leadership-insights.title: Leadership insights
leadership-insights.purpose: HR aggregates for the academy: 360 averages by grade and nominations by status, suppressed below 10.

communities.title: Communities of practice
communities.purpose: Communities by discipline with moderated Q&A, an expert finder for people who opted in and the knowledge-sharing session catalogue.

communities-detail.title: Community
communities-detail.purpose: One community: charter, steward, events and Q&A threads.

community-thread.title: Thread
community-thread.purpose: One Q&A thread in a community of practice.

communities-experts.title: Expert finder
communities-experts.purpose: Find colleagues who opted in as experts in a skill (level 3 or above) and send an in-app request.

communities-sessions.title: Knowledge-sharing sessions
communities-sessions.purpose: Search past knowledge-sharing sessions and recordings, and see upcoming sessions.

stepDesc.ic: Leads by example: questioning attitude, accountability and coaching peers.
stepDesc.first_line: Leads a crew or team: briefs, standards, coaching and conservative decisions.
stepDesc.manager: Leads leaders: performance, development and safety culture across teams.
stepDesc.director: Shapes a function: station performance, engagement and long-term capability.
stepDesc.executive: Sets culture and direction for the organisation's vision.

b-safety-values.title: Safety values and actions
b-safety-values.statement: Puts nuclear safety first in words and decisions, even under schedule pressure.

b-accountability.title: Personal accountability
b-accountability.statement: Owns outcomes, follows through and holds the standard for themselves first.

b-questioning.title: Questioning attitude
b-questioning.statement: Challenges assumptions and stops when unsure; invites others to do the same.

b-communication.title: Effective safety communication
b-communication.statement: Communicates clearly and checks understanding, in briefs and turnovers.

b-decisions.title: Conservative decision-making
b-decisions.statement: Makes decisions that are systematic, conservative and explained to the team.

b-respect.title: Respectful work environment
b-respect.statement: Treats people with dignity and builds trust across teams.

b-learning.title: Continuous learning
b-learning.statement: Seeks feedback, learns from experience and develops others.

b-concerns.title: Environment for raising concerns
b-concerns.statement: Makes it easy and safe for anyone to raise a concern, and acts on it.

reasons.readiness: {pct}% ready on the leadership competencies for {step} (nomination and programmes are separate)
reasons.required_track: Required on the shift supervisor track (ROs and SROs take INTILAQA as Leading Effective Teams)
reasons.nomination_nominated: You have been nominated (waiting for a decision)
reasons.nomination_declined: An earlier nomination was declined; ask your manager about the next cycle
reasons.expert_basis_verified: Verified by a current qualification record
reasons.expert_basis_evidenced: Evidenced by training, assessments or signed-off work
reasons.expert_optin: Chose to be findable in the expert finder

leadership.intro: The Enterprise Nuclear Leadership Academy as a pathway: what each step of the ladder asks of you, the programmes that build it (with the published facts and their source), and where you stand today.
leadership.empty: No leadership programmes are published yet
leadership.readyFor: {pct}% ready on the leadership competencies for {step}
leadership.readinessNote: A planning aid from your skills passport, not a selection decision. Nomination is a line-manager action and HR decides.
leadership.checkInNote: A self check-in is recorded as a self-rating in your skills passport (claimed). Your manager can validate it later; qualification evidence always wins.
leadership.ladderSub: Five steps, each with the academy programmes that prepare for it. Open a programme for its facts and source.
leadership.recoTitle: Next in the academy for you
leadership.recoSub: Required programmes first, then programmes for your next step weighted by the leadership gaps they address. Every card says why.
leadership.allSub: Published facts from the UAE national report to the 10th CNS review meeting (March 2026).
leadership.myNominationsSub: Nominations your line manager made for you and the HR decision.
leadership.noNominationsBody: Talk to your line manager in your next career conversation; nominations are made by managers, not by application.
leadership.cultureSub: The behaviours rated in the leadership 360, each linked to a trait of a healthy nuclear safety culture (INPO 12-012).
leadership.mirrorTitle: A pathway view, not an HR record
leadership.mirrorBody: Kafa'a shows the academy as a pathway with published facts. Places, nominations and completions are decided and recorded by the leadership development team and HR; readiness is a planning aid only.

checkin.title: Check in: {skill}
checkin.body: Your passport shows level {have}; the target for your next step is {need}. Choose the level you work at today and say what shows it.
checkin.noteHint: For example: "Ran the pre-job briefs for the crew during the last outage."
checkin.claimed: Recorded as a self-rating (claimed) in your skills passport, audited. It never changes a qualification.

programme.requiredTrackBody: Reactor operators and senior reactor operators take INTILAQA as Leading Effective Teams (LET) on the way to shift supervisor.
programme.requiredStepBody: INTILAQA is the mandatory first-line leadership programme; you take it when you first lead a team.
programme.joinNomination: Your line manager nominates you; HR decides.
programme.joinOther: No nomination in Kafa'a: see the note on this page.
programme.factsSub: Each fact links to the national report with the date it was checked.
programme.perSource: Figures are as published in the source ("per source"); Kafa'a does not count completions itself.
programme.buildsSub: Leadership competencies against the target for {step}, and the behaviours it strengthens.
programme.askManager: Not nominated yet. Ask your line manager in your next career conversation.
programme.notNominable: This programme has no nomination step in Kafa'a.
programme.managerBody: Nominate someone you manage. HR decides; you cannot decide your own nominations.

nominate.title: Nominate for a leadership programme
nominate.noTeam: Nobody in your scope is listed.
nominate.reasonHint: 10 to 500 characters: what the person is ready for. Never include medical or personal details.
nominate.makerCheckerBody: You nominate; the HR authority or the training manager decides. Nobody decides their own nomination or one they made. A nominee can never nominate themselves.

nom.intro: Nominations to academy programmes: line managers nominate, the HR authority or the training manager decides, and every decision is audited and recorded in the NEXUS ledger.
nom.queueNote: You cannot decide a nomination you made, or your own.
nom.blockedMaker: You made this nomination, so another decision-maker must decide it.
nom.blockedSelf: This is your own nomination; another decision-maker must decide it.
nom.declineReason: Reason (shared with the person and the nominator)
nom.approveBody: The person and their manager are notified. The decision is audited and recorded in the NEXUS ledger.
nom.declineBody: Say why and what would help next time. The decision is audited and recorded in the NEXUS ledger.
nom.teamBody: Nominate people you manage. The HR authority or the training manager decides.
nom.teamEmpty: You have not nominated anyone yet
nom.allSub: Every nomination you are allowed to see, with CSV export.

r360.intro: Feedback on eight leadership behaviours from colleagues you choose. Results appear only as averages, and only once five or more people have responded.
r360.privacyBody: Ratings are stored without the rater's name. People see their own results only as averages and only with at least {n} responses; HR sees grade-level averages only for groups of 10 or more. Nobody, including admins, can read an individual answer.
r360.noCycleBody: Ask five or more colleagues for feedback in the "Ask for feedback" tab.
r360.notEnoughBody: {have} of the {need} responses needed. Results stay hidden until enough colleagues respond, so nobody can be identified.
r360.resultsSub: Average of colleagues (1 to 5) next to your self rating, with the range of answers.
r360.inviteesNote: Kafa'a never shows who has answered.
r360.noInvites: Nobody has asked you for feedback
r360.submitBody: Your rating is stored without your name and cannot be changed afterwards.
r360.requestBody: Choose {min} to {max} colleagues who see you lead: your manager, peers and people you lead. Your self rating is added for you.
r360.alreadyInvited: You already invited {n} colleagues this cycle; new names are added to them.
r360.sendBody: {n} colleagues will get an in-app request. You will see results only as averages, once five or more respond.

insights.intro: Aggregates only. Leadership-behaviour 360 averages by grade and nominations by status; every cell with fewer than 10 people is suppressed.
insights.noAccess: These aggregates are for HR and auditors
insights.nomSub: All programmes and cycles. Counts under 10 are suppressed.
insights.r360Sub: Average colleague rating (1 to 5) for subjects with at least five responses; grades with fewer than 10 such people are suppressed.
insights.r360Note: The number in brackets is how many people the average covers. Self ratings are excluded.
insights.factsSub: As published in the national report (per source).
insights.privacyBody: HR never sees an individual's 360 results or any rater's answers. Use career conversations and talent review for individual development.

cop.intro: Communities of practice by discipline: ask and answer questions, share lessons learned, find who knows what, and catch the next knowledge-sharing session.
cop.allSub: Each has a charter and a steward who moderates. Join to post.
cop.leaveBody: You can rejoin at any time. Your posts stay in the community.
cop.eventsSub: Community events: sessions open to all staff.
cop.rulesBody: Careers, learning and lessons learned only. Never post plant security, safeguards or cyber details, procedures or setpoints, or anyone's contact details: such posts are refused automatically. A steward checks your first post in each community.
cop.joinToPost: Join this community to ask or answer.
cop.noThreads: No questions yet: start the first one
cop.postHint: No security, safeguards or cyber details and no contact details. Your first post in a community waits for a steward.
cop.hideBody: The post is hidden from the community; the author sees your reason. The action is audited.
cop.publishBody: The post becomes visible to all staff. The action is audited.
cop.heldNote: Only you can see this until a steward publishes it.

experts.intro: Find colleagues who chose to be findable for a skill they hold at level 3 or above. You see their role, team and how the level is evidenced, never contact details: connect with an in-app request.
experts.none: No opted-in experts for this skill yet
experts.noneBody: Try a related skill, or ask the community: stewards often know who can help.
experts.inApp: Requests stay in Kafa'a: no email or phone numbers. Messages are screened like community posts.
experts.note: Only people who opted in appear here, and only for skills at level {n} or above in their skills passport.
experts.noEligibleBody: You can list skills once your passport shows level {n} or above.
experts.optinBody: Choose up to eight skills at level {n} or above. Colleagues see your name, role, team and these skills only.
experts.headline: Headline (optional)
experts.listTitle: List yourself in the expert finder?
experts.listBody: Colleagues will find you for the skills you chose and can send you in-app requests. You can hide yourself at any time.
experts.hideTitle: Hide yourself from the expert finder?
experts.hideBody: You will no longer appear in results. Requests you already received stay in your list.
experts.privacyBody: Nobody appears in the expert finder unless they choose to. Security, safeguards and cyber skills are never listed.
experts.replyHint: Suggest when and where to meet inside work. No contact details.

sessions.intro: Knowledge-sharing sessions with recordings, and upcoming sessions. Search works in English and Arabic.
sessions.searchHint: For example: outage, الذكاء الاصطناعي, proficiency
sessions.none: No sessions for this community yet
sessions.recordingBody: In this demo, recordings are synthetic references ({ref}); in production this links to the session recording in the learning system.
sessions.factBody: In 2024 knowledge-sharing sessions covered proficiency, outage lessons learned, project management, artificial intelligence, main control room operations in a simulated environment and radiation safety (per source). Session titles and recordings here are synthetic.
